questions.questionText: If the price of sugar increases by 25%, by what percentage must a household reduce its consumption so that the expenditure remains unchanged?
questions.explanation: Let initial price = ₹100, consumption = 100 kg, initial expenditure = ₹10,000. New price = ₹125. To keep expenditure at ₹10,000, new consumption = 10,000 / 125 = 80 kg. Reduction = 100 - 80 = 20%. Formula: [r / (100 + r)] × 100% = (25 / 125) × 100 = 20%.

questions.questionText: A merchant marks his goods 40% above the cost price and allows a discount of 15% on the marked price. In addition, he gives a 5% cash discount on the discounted price. What is his net profit percentage?
questions.explanation: Let CP = 100. MP = 140. First discount 15%: Price = 140 × 0.85 = 119. Cash discount 5%: SP = 119 × 0.95 = 113.05. Profit = SP - CP = 113.05 - 100 = 13.05%.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are in the ratio 7 : 11. If 7 is added to each number, the ratio becomes 2 : 3. What is the smaller number?
A can complete a piece of work in 16 days, and B can complete the same work in 24 days. They work together for 6 days, after which A leaves. In how many more days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.explanation: Total work = LCM(16, 24) = 48 units. Efficiency of A = 3 units/day, B = 2 units/day. In 6 days, work done = 6 × (3 + 2) = 30 units. Remaining work = 48 - 30 = 18 units. Time taken by B = 18 / 2 = 9 days.

questions.questionText: A train 240 meters long passes a pole in 16 seconds and passes a platform in 36 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
questions.explanation: Speed of train = 240 / 16 = 15 m/s. Let platform length = L. Total distance in 36 seconds = 240 + L = 15 × 36 = 540 m. Platform length L = 540 - 240 = 300 meters.

questions.questionText:
Statements:
1. All accounts are ledgers.
2. Some ledgers are journals.
3. No journal is a voucher.

Conclusions:
I. Some ledgers are not vouchers.
II. No account is a voucher.
questions.explanation: Ledgers that are journals cannot be vouchers since no journal is a voucher. Hence, some ledgers are definitely not vouchers (Conclusion I follows). Accounts may or may not overlap with vouchers in potential diagrams, so Conclusion II is not a definite conclusion.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, "FINANCE" is written as "HKPCPEG". How will "AUDITOR" be written in that code language?
questions.explanation: Pattern: Each letter is shifted forward by +2. A(+2)=C, U(+2)=W, D(+2)=F, I(+2)=K, T(+2)=V, O(+2)=Q, R(+2)=T. Therefore, "CWFKVQT".

questions.questionText: Pointing to a portrait in an office, Rohit said, "His mother is the only daughter of my maternal grandfather." How is Rohit related to the person in the portrait?
questions.explanation: Only daughter of Rohit maternal grandfather is Rohit mother. The portrait person mother is Rohit mother. Therefore, the person is Rohit brother.

questions.questionText: A bank inspector travels 12 km East from branch A to branch B, then turns left and travels 9 km North to reach the regional office. What is the shortest distance between branch A and the regional office?
questions.explanation: Forming a right-angled triangle with legs 12 km and 9 km. Hypotenuse = √(12^2 + 9^2) = √(144 + 81) = √225 = 15 km.

questions.questionText:
Statement: P ≥ Q > R = S ≤ T < U

Conclusions:
I. P > R
II. U > S
questions.explanation: From P ≥ Q > R, strictly P > R holds (I is true). From S ≤ T < U, strictly S < U holds, so U > S (II is true). Both follow.

options.optionText: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.questionText:
Identify the part of the sentence containing a grammatical error:

"Neither the branch manager (A) / nor the loan officers (B) / was aware of the recent (C) / regulatory amendments issued by the RBI. (D)"
questions.explanation: In "neither... nor" constructions, the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, "the loan officers" is plural, so the verb must be plural "were aware", not singular "was aware". Hence error is in Part (C).

questions.questionText:
Choose the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to the word:

METICULOUS
questions.explanation: "Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. "Perfunctory" means carried out with minimal effort or careless haste, making it the antonym.

questions.questionText:
Complete the sentence with the most appropriate option:

The committee recommended stringent measures to ______ the proliferation of non-performing assets in state-run banks.
questions.explanation: "Curtail" means to reduce in extent or quantity; impose a restriction on, which fits the context of curbing bad loans.

questions.questionText:
Passage excerpt: "Central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) represent sovereign currency in electronic format, combining the safety and resilience of central bank money with modern payments efficiency. Unlike volatile decentralized cryptocurrencies, retail CBDCs provide riskless settlement for consumers without intermediation costs."

According to the passage, what is a primary distinction between retail CBDCs and decentralized cryptocurrencies?
questions.explanation: The excerpt highlights that CBDCs are sovereign electronic currency providing riskless settlement, in explicit contrast to decentralized cryptocurrencies which are volatile.

options.optionText: CBDCs carry sovereign backing and provide riskless settlement
Cryptocurrencies are strictly issued by national treasuries
CBDCs possess higher price volatility than private tokens
CBDCs impose higher intermediation fees on everyday consumers

questions.questionText:
Select the best replacement for the underlined segment:

"Had the board verified the balance sheet earlier, the discrepancy *would have been prevented*."
questions.explanation: Third conditional pattern: "Had + subject + past participle, subject + would have been + past participle" for passive outcome. The sentence is grammatically correct as written.

options.optionText: would have been prevented (No improvement needed)

questions.questionText: Which entity regulates and supervises Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) in India after the statutory transfer of regulatory powers in 2019?
questions.explanation: Regulatory powers over Housing Finance Companies were transferred from the National Housing Bank (NHB) to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) through the Finance Act, 2019.

questions.questionText: What is the statutory composition of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of India in terms of total voting members?
questions.explanation: Under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the MPC consists of six members: three from the RBI (including the Governor as Chairperson with a casting vote) and three external members appointed by the Central Government.

options.optionText: 6 members (3 RBI, 3 external nominated by the Government)

questions.questionText: What is the maximum limit for domestic transactions executed under UPI123Pay per transaction without smartphone internet connectivity?
questions.explanation: RBI enhanced the per-transaction limit for UPI123Pay (UPI for feature phones) from ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 to foster rural digital payments.

questions.questionText: Where is the headquarters of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) located?
questions.explanation: AIIB is headquartered in Beijing, China. (ADB is in Manila, Philippines; NDB is in Shanghai, China).

questions.explanation: Under the revised PCA framework, profitability (Return on Assets) was removed as a direct trigger parameter; the primary indicators monitored are Capital (CRAR/CET1), Asset Quality (Net NPA), and Leverage.
